epic_title: Synchrony Enterprise GenAI Evaluation & Observability Gateway (Langfuse Self-Hosted)

stories.title: Deploy Self-Hosted Langfuse v3 & ClickHouse Cluster in Synchrony Private VPC (ROSA OpenShift)
gherkin_acceptance_criteria: Given the Synchrony private VPC runtime, When Langfuse v3 and ClickHouse containers are deployed on UBI9 (UID 1001), Then 100% of telemetry spans remain inside Synchrony private subnets with zero external egress.
Given 5M monthly telemetry spans, When ClickHouse is queried for evaluation traces, Then P95 query latency is under 200ms.

stories.title: Build FastAPI OpenTelemetry W3C TraceContext Proxy with Entra ID JWKS Caching
gherkin_acceptance_criteria: Given an incoming LLM telemetry request with a W3C traceparent header and Entra ID Bearer JWT, When the proxy validates the token against its 300s local JWKS cache, Then auth completes in <2ms and total proxy P95 overhead stays <25ms.
Given a missing traceparent header, When the proxy ingests the span, Then it synthesizes a compliant W3C TraceContext ID before forwarding asynchronously.

stories.title: Implement Safe Inline PCI-DSS v4.0 (PAN/SSN) & CareCredit HIPAA (MRN) Regex Scrubber
gherkin_acceptance_criteria: Given a telemetry span containing a 16-digit PAN, 9-digit SSN, or CareCredit MRN, When sanitize_telemetry_payload() executes via json.dumps and compiled regex, Then sensitive tokens are replaced with [REDACTED_PAN], [REDACTED_SSN], and [REDACTED_MRN].
Given security static analysis in Bitbucket Pipelines, When proxy_gateway.py is scanned, Then zero eval() calls exist.

stories.title: Decouple Deprecated Kong Gateway v3.4 & Configure Internal Envoy Service Mesh Sidecar (+2 Sprints Curveball)
gherkin_acceptance_criteria: Given Q1 Kong Enterprise Gateway v3.4 deprecation, When OpenShift pods are deployed with mesh.syf.bank/injected: 'true', Then all east-west OTel trace spans route through Envoy sidecars with mTLS 1.3.
Given service mesh ingress, When telemetry spans are ingested, Then zero plain-text token leakage occurs in container logs.
